language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The robot grasps the wooden spoon by its handle in frames 54–69 (wrist_image), then lifts and carries it toward the open drawer in frames 70–136 (left_ego_image and wrist_image). It releases the spoon into the drawer in frames 137–142; the spoon is visibly resting inside in frames 143–150 (image and wrist_image). The gripper withdraws empty through frame 163, while the spoon remains in the drawer (image). No failed acquisition, unintended displacement of other objects, or damage is visible.
